comparison.objective: Lock a bicycle wheel to a stand using a U-lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Thread a rigid shackle through spokes and around the stand, then align and seat a crossbar on both legs.
comparison.success_condition: Lock closed around both rim and stand, both shackle ends engaged, released and still.
comparison.reason: Multi-obstacle threading and dual-leg closure are different from transferring a recirculating-ball block across a flush, parallel support junction.
